records.text: Atlas API listens on port 8320. Configure server/config.rs.
Atlas API now listens on port 9440. Configure server/config.rs; 8320 is obsolete.
Run cargo test --offline for Atlas Rust tests. Integration fixtures use disposable SQLite databases.
Atlas HTTP authentication uses a Bearer token from ATLAS_TOKEN. Never log the token. Implementation: server/auth.rs.
Atlas payment webhooks retry with exponential backoff, maximum three attempts. Deduplicate using event_id in payments/webhook.rs.
Atlas SQLite migrations run inside an immediate transaction in storage/migrate.rs. Back up before schema upgrades.
Atlas caches compiled templates in an LRU cache capped at 128 entries. Source: render/cache.rs.
아틀라스 배포는 금요일에 하지 않는다. 배포 전에 스테이징에서 회귀 테스트를 실행하고 이전 바이너리를 보관한다.
모든 예약 작업의 시간대는 UTC다. 화면에만 사용자의 지역 시간대를 적용한다. scheduler/time.rs에서 변환한다.
Atlas request logs retain only request_id and status_code. Request bodies and credentials must be redacted.
Beacon API listens on port 8320. Configure server/config.rs.
Beacon tests run with pnpm test, not cargo. Integration tests use PostgreSQL containers.
Beacon payment webhooks retry ten times with fixed delay. Implementation: payments/webhook.rs.
The landing page uses purple buttons and a lighthouse illustration. Design notes are in web/theme.css.
Development lunch notes: try the new coffee shop near the office on Tuesday.
A rejected idea was to rewrite the renderer in Java. No migration was approved.
